final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_clients, AVG(rs.share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.share - a.share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM region_shares AS rs CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE rs.share > a.share
